name: contradiction_policy_version_bump
transcript_text:
Irene: The data retention policy has been updated from 90 days to 180 days. The Privacy Policy page and the Compliance Checklist both state 90 days — both need updating.
James: Correct, 180 days is the new standard per legal review.
